provenance: Jen call, 3 Jun 2026 (strategy brief evidence log): pipeline concentrated in high-value high-risk £100k+ funders; explicitly wants reliable £20-25k multi-year unrestricted. The canonical Companion situation.

expected.judge_guidance: A 5 leads with the real constraint: the entire £580k pipeline sits with two funders (Large Foundation A appears twice, £400k of it) against a £1.02m gap, mostly single-year restricted, while the goal asks for multi-year unrestricted. It should recommend rebalancing toward the £20-30k multi-year unrestricted band (the synthetic Steadfast fixture is the planted right answer) BEFORE or alongside any new big bid, and explain sequencing against the existing submitted/applying items. A 2-3 produces a generic 'here are more education grants' list, recommends another £150k+ bid (syn-another-big-bid is the planted trap - recommending it without addressing concentration is the failure) or buries concentration in a footnote. Watch R5: a senior consultant would name the double-exposure to Large Foundation A specifically.

notes: The single most important case in the set: it encodes the Companion's reason to exist for the paying heartland. Henry Smith pinned refs add real catalogue shape; if absent from snapshot, the case still functions on synthetics + pool.
